events.title: BTC dipped below $80,000 in the last 24 hours (low $79,369) and recovered

messages.text:
**Daily Market Summary · 26 October 2026**

**Alert**
• Bitcoin dipped below $80,000 in the last 24 hours (low $79,369) and recovered. The dip was brief, but $80,000 is a round level many people watch.

**Snapshot**
• Bitcoin about $80,200, down 2.2% over 7 days and about 26% above three months ago.
• Headline BULLISH, confidence high. Fear & Greed is 50 (neutral), and daily price swings are among the calmest in years.

**What happened (last 24h)**
• Price slipped under $80,000 and came back. No single cause is reported; the market is waiting for the Fed decision on 27–28 October.
• Small holders keep buying: deposits from small Bitcoin holders to Binance hit a six-month high while large holders' deposits keep falling (Darkfost via PANews).
• About $109M of leveraged bets were forced to close on 25 October, split fairly evenly between buyers and sellers (CoinGlass via PANews).

**Short-term outlook (next 1–7 days)**
• Short term is soft to neutral: price has closed below its 50-day average for five days and is about 7% under its 30-day high, while the mood is neutral and moves are calm. Expect choppy days until the Fed speaks.
• Turns up: a daily close above $81,822 (50-day average); next stop $86,480 (30-day high).
• Sideways: between $78,750 and $81,822 (a typical week lately swings about $2,670), back-and-forth with no clear direction.
• Turns down: a daily close below $78,750; the bigger floor is $72,993 (200-day average).
• Rally watch: no signal. A rally signal needs a close above $88,493, a drop signal a close below $75,383.
• This week: Fed decision 27–28 October, then US GDP and inflation data (Jin10 via PANews).

**News that matters**
• South Korea leans toward delaying its 22% crypto tax a fourth time (PANews): medium term, small positive.
• US lawmakers agreed another detail of the CLARITY Act, the crypto market-rules bill (PANews): medium term, small positive.
• Latvia plans rules for tokenized real-world assets in H1 2027 (PANews): long term, small positive.

**Altcoins & themes**
• Tokenized stocks on-chain passed $1B, up about 800% in a year (Token Terminal via PANews).
• CoinDCX will cover a 15.99M USDT loss from an old wallet; user funds are safe (PANews).

**Bigger picture**
• Next month is mixed: the three-month numbers still lean up, but the last few weeks have faded, so it stays neutral with an upward tilt until price wins back $81,822. 3–6 months leans up with the most confidence, and that recovery stays intact while price holds above $72,993.

Dashboard: https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

*Paid:* raise active-trader spend in small steps with a weekly review, and keep part of the increase flexible until after the Fed decision (28 October). Be ready to pause if price closes below $78,750 or slides toward $75,383, where a drop signal would start. Keep rally creatives ready to go live within days if price rises above $88,493.

*Social:* keep the normal rhythm with an explain-the-news tone. Post a plain "why is Bitcoin near $80,000?" note (no single cause is reported; the market is waiting for the Fed) and the Fed-week explainer for 27–28 October. Explain, don't predict.

*CRM:* send existing users a calm note about the dip and how Reku keeps funds safe, with no promotions today. Queue the welcome and first-deposit journey now: after past rallies, new sign-ups and first deposits rose about 2–4 weeks later.
